checklistGeneric: Audit performed against the current published audit rubric version
Scores and rationale recorded in the audit record
checklistSpecific: Open the Coverage tab and confirm a written coverage position letter or memo is attached and dated within standards
Compare the declarations page limits, deductible and endorsements cited in the coverage analysis against the policy in the policy record
Score liability determination: confirm comparative/contributory fault percentage is stated with supporting facts, not a bare conclusion
Open the reserve worksheet and check indemnity plus expense reserve against paid-to-date and the current damages evaluation
Flag any reserve movement over 25% from the initial reserve with no corresponding file note as a reserve-adequacy deficiency

testing.expected: A dated coverage position document exists on the audited claim
Each reserve change carries a rationale note

checklistGeneric: Calibration session attendance recorded
Final agreed score written back to the audit record
checklistSpecific: Pull the disputed-score queue and list every audit where the adjuster rebuttal is open past 10 business days
Re-read the same file blind with a second auditor and record both independent scores before discussion
Where scores differ by more than one band, log the rubric line item that caused the split
Agree a single final score per disputed element and record the agreed rationale in the calibration minutes
Raise a rubric-clarification action for any rubric line that split the panel twice or more

testing.expected: Disputed audits show an original score, a calibrated score, and a calibration note
No audit remains in Disputed status after the calibration session closes

checklistGeneric: Debrief held with the handling adjuster within the standard turnaround
Corrective actions agreed with named owner and due date
checklistSpecific: Walk the adjuster through each deficiency line on the scorecard citing the specific file note, letter or reserve entry
Confirm the adjuster acknowledges or formally rebuts each deficiency and record which
Agree file-level corrective actions (e.g. issue missing reservation-of-rights letter, re-document reserve rationale) with due dates
Record the debrief date, attendees and agreed actions on the audit record
Copy the adjuster supervisor on the debrief summary where the file scored below the pass threshold

testing.expected: Debrief date, attendees and adjuster acknowledgement are recorded
No closed audit lacks a debrief entry for a below-threshold score

checklistGeneric: Audit record completed in the quality management system, not offline
Evidence links attached to each scored deficiency
checklistSpecific: Create the audit record against the claim number and select the correct audit type (random, targeted, post-training)
Enter the score for every rubric element; do not leave elements blank to force a pass
Tag each deficiency to its category (coverage, investigation, reserving, documentation, timeliness, customer contact)
Attach or deep-link the file note, letter or financial entry that evidences each deficiency
Set the audit status to Complete and confirm it appears in the current period quality scorecard extract

testing.expected: The audited claim has a Complete audit record with a category tag per deficiency
No audit record sits in Draft status after the period close date

checklistGeneric: Escalation raised with supporting evidence, not anecdote
Named management owner accepts the issue
checklistSpecific: Group the period deficiencies by category and identify any category failing on more than 15% of audited files
Confirm the pattern repeats across at least two adjusters or two teams before calling it systemic, not file-specific
Write the issue statement with population size, failure rate, and the two or three exemplar claim numbers
Raise the issue to claims management with a recommended intervention (process change, guideline update, or targeted training)
Log the issue in the GRC issue register with an owner and target remediation date

testing.expected: Systemic quality issue is logged with owner, failure rate and target date
Issue statement cites the audit population size and exemplar claim numbers

checklistGeneric: Every checklist line evaluated, none left unanswered
Missing-document findings evidenced by a repository check
checklistSpecific: Confirm the loss notice, policy declarations and coverage position are all attached to the claim file
Check that every material activity in the last 90 days has a contemporaneous file note within 24 hours of the activity
Confirm recorded statements, estimates and photographs are attached and linked to the claim, not held in personal folders
Verify all outbound correspondence (acknowledgement, ROR, status, denial) is stored in the document repository against the claim
Mark the file deficient where a decision was made with no supporting document or note in the file

testing.expected: Loss notice, declarations, correspondence and evidence are all indexed to the claim
No material activity in the review window lacks a corresponding file note

checklistGeneric: Timeline test run against the state rule set applicable to the loss state
Every breach recorded with the actual elapsed time
checklistSpecific: Compute elapsed time from FNOL receipt to acknowledgement and test against the loss-state acknowledgement rule
Compute elapsed time from assignment to first substantive insured contact and test against the 24-hour standard
Check that any denial or partial denial letter issued within the required window states the specific policy provision relied on
Check status-update letters were issued at the required interval on files open beyond the state investigation window
Record each breach with claim number, control point, required days and actual days

testing.expected: Acknowledgement, contact and decision timestamps are populated on every sampled claim
No sampled denial letter omits the policy provision relied on

checklistGeneric: Current-version scorecard used for the whole sample period
Score total reconciles to the sum of element weights
checklistSpecific: Score each rubric section (coverage, investigation, evaluation, reserving, documentation, timeliness, customer service) individually
Assign each deficiency to a category and severity (critical, major, minor) using the published definitions
Mark any leakage-bearing deficiency (overpayment, missed subrogation, missed deductible) as critical regardless of section score
Confirm the weighted total recalculates correctly and compare against the pass threshold
Record a one-line written rationale for every element scored below full marks

testing.expected: Weighted total equals the sum of scored elements and a rationale exists for each deduction
No scorecard records a leakage deficiency at less than critical severity

checklistGeneric: Sample size meets the minimum monthly review percentage
Sampling method and seed documented so the draw is reproducible
checklistSpecific: Pull the closed-and-open claim population for the period from the warehouse with line of business, adjuster and severity band
Draw the random component using a documented random seed so the selection can be reproduced on request
Add targeted-trigger files: large loss over threshold, reopened claims, litigated files, complaint files, and new-hire adjusters
Confirm the combined sample meets the 10% monthly review minimum and covers every adjuster at least once per quarter
Publish the sample list with claim numbers, adjuster and trigger reason to the audit queue

testing.expected: Sample extract records the seed, population count and trigger reason per claim
Sampled file count is at least the 10% monthly minimum of the eligible population

checklistGeneric: Every open remediation action has an owner and a due date
Overdue actions escalated rather than silently extended
checklistSpecific: Refresh the open corrective-action list and flag every action past its due date
For each action, confirm the evidence attached actually demonstrates the fix (letter issued, reserve corrected, note added)
Chase the action owner and their supervisor on any action more than 10 business days overdue
Close only actions with attached evidence; return unsupported closures to the owner with a reason
Report open, closed and overdue action counts by team into the monthly quality pack

testing.expected: Every open action shows an owner, due date and current status
No action is marked Closed without attached remediation evidence

checklistGeneric: Prior-period findings re-tested on the same files, not on a fresh sample only
Recurrence recorded as a repeat finding
checklistSpecific: Pull the prior audit round findings for the adjuster or team being re-tested
Reopen each previously deficient claim file and check the specific corrective action was actually performed
Where the same deficiency category recurs on a new file, tag it as a repeat finding on the current scorecard
Escalate any finding recurring for a second consecutive round to the adjuster supervisor
Update the prior audit record to Verified or Not Remediated with the evidence reference

testing.expected: Each prior finding shows a Verified or Not Remediated verification outcome
No prior finding remains in Awaiting Verification after two audit cycles

checklistGeneric: Extract built from the warehouse of record, not a desktop copy
Record counts reconciled to source before release
checklistSpecific: Run the APCD extract for the reporting period using the state-published file layout and version
Validate mandatory fields (member/claimant id, service dates, paid amount, denial reason code) are populated on every row
Reconcile total paid amount and record count on the extract back to the claims ledger for the same period
Run the state edit/validation routine and clear every fatal edit before submission packaging
Record the extract version, run date and validation results in the filing log

testing.expected: Extract row count and paid total reconcile to the claims ledger for the period
No fatal validation edits remain unresolved on the submitted extract

checklistGeneric: Each exception has a documented root cause, not just a corrective action
Closure approved by someone other than the action owner
checklistSpecific: List every open claims compliance exception with age, state, and rule breached
Confirm a root cause is recorded for each exception (training gap, system defect, workload, guideline gap)
Verify the remediation evidence attached matches the exception (corrected letter, back-dated acknowledgement note, system fix ticket)
Obtain independent closure review and record the reviewer name and date
Escalate any exception open beyond the 30-day standard to the Chief Claims Officer report

testing.expected: Every closed exception carries a root cause and an independent closure approver
No exception is closed by the same person who owned the remediation action

checklistGeneric: Filing built from claim system data, not manual re-keying
Jurisdiction edit rules applied before assembly is called complete
checklistSpecific: Identify every workers compensation claim with a reportable event in the period (first report, payment start, suspension, final payment)
Map each event to the correct EDI maintenance type code for the filing jurisdiction
Validate injured-worker identifiers, date of injury, body part and nature-of-injury codes against the jurisdiction code lists
Run the jurisdiction edit package and correct every rejectable error before packaging
Attach the assembled FROI/SROI batch to the filing log with the target jurisdiction and due date

testing.system: Claims management platform (Guidewire ClaimCenter/Duck Creek Claims)
testing.expected: Every reportable event in the period has a mapped maintenance type code
No record in the assembled batch fails jurisdiction edits

checklistGeneric: Response issued inside the DOI-stated due date
Response reviewed before release, not sent direct by the handler
checklistSpecific: Open the complaint record and confirm the DOI due date and required response format are captured
Pull the full claim chronology and every relevant letter to support the factual narrative
Draft the response answering each specific DOI allegation point by point with document references
Route the draft for compliance and, where coverage is contested, legal review before submission
Submit through the DOI portal and file the submission confirmation and response copy against the claim and complaint records

testing.expected: Complaint record shows DOI due date, response date and submission confirmation
No DOI complaint response is sent after the regulator due date without a documented extension

checklistGeneric: Calendar covers every state in which the entity is licensed to write
Each obligation has a named owner and lead time
checklistSpecific: Reconcile the calendar against the licensed-states list and add any state with no entry
Record for each obligation the filing name, jurisdiction, frequency, statutory due date and internal lead date
Add scheduled and announced market conduct exam dates and their document-production windows
Assign a named preparer and reviewer to every calendar line
Circulate the 90-day forward view to claims compliance and operations at each month end

testing.expected: Each calendar entry has jurisdiction, due date, lead date, preparer and reviewer
No licensed state is missing from the claims compliance calendar

checklistGeneric: Monitoring run every period against the current state rule matrix
Breaches routed to an owner, not just reported
checklistSpecific: Refresh the state rule matrix for acknowledgement, investigation and decision deadlines by loss state and line
Run the timeline monitor over all open and recently closed claims for the period
Produce the exception list showing claim, loss state, control point, required days and actual days
Route each exception to the handling adjuster supervisor with a response due date
Track the breach rate by state and line and flag any state breaching above tolerance for escalation

testing.expected: Monitor output shows required versus actual elapsed days per control point
No open breach lacks an assigned supervisor and response due date

checklistGeneric: Every alert dispositioned as applicable or not applicable with a reason
Applicable changes handed to an implementation owner
checklistSpecific: Review the regulatory alert feed and bulletin sources for claims-handling changes in every licensed state
Record each change with jurisdiction, effective date, source citation and short summary
Assess claims impact: which handling guideline, letter template, SLA or system rule is affected
Mark not-applicable items with the reason so the disposition is auditable
Raise an implementation item with owner and due date for every applicable change ahead of its effective date

testing.expected: Each tracked change has jurisdiction, effective date, source citation and disposition
No alert remains undispositioned past its effective date

checklistGeneric: Report built to the current statistical plan layout version
Figures reconciled to the general ledger and claims ledger
checklistSpecific: Pull loss-run and bordereaux data for the reporting period by state, line and coverage
Confirm paid loss, outstanding reserve and claim counts reconcile to the claims ledger and financial close figures
Apply the statistical agent code mappings (cause of loss, coverage, class) for the reporting jurisdiction
Investigate and document any variance over tolerance versus the prior period submission
Package the report with the reconciliation worksheet and route for reviewer sign-off

testing.expected: Paid, reserve and count totals reconcile to the claims ledger for the period
Report package includes a signed reconciliation worksheet before submission

checklistGeneric: Metrics sourced from the monitoring system, not hand-built
Period-over-period movement explained
checklistSpecific: Compile the period metrics: timeline compliance rate, open exceptions by age, DOI complaint volume and outcomes
Show movement versus prior period and versus the stated tolerance for each metric
List every exception open beyond 30 days with owner and reason for delay
Summarise regulatory changes taking effect in the next quarter and their claims readiness status
Circulate the pack to the Chief Claims Officer and legal/compliance leadership and record the distribution date

testing.expected: Pack shows current period, prior period and tolerance for each metric
Distribution date and recipient list are recorded for the published pack

checklistGeneric: Rates reported by state and line, not as a single blended number
Denominator definition stated on the report
checklistSpecific: Calculate acknowledgement compliance rate as acknowledged-in-time over total FNOLs for the period by loss state
Calculate investigation-window compliance rate over claims reaching the state investigation deadline in the period
Calculate denial-decision compliance rate over all denials and partial denials issued in the period
State the denominator definition and any exclusions directly on the report page
Highlight every state-line combination below the internal tolerance and name the accountable claims manager

testing.expected: Report shows separate acknowledgement, investigation and denial rates by state and line
Denominator definition and exclusions are printed on the report

checklistGeneric: Single point of contact controls all examiner communication
Every document released is logged before it leaves
checklistSpecific: Log the exam notice, scope, review period, states involved and examiner contact in the exam record
Pull the requested claim population and reconcile the file count back to the examiner request criteria
Review each requested file for completeness and privilege before production; log privilege withholds with the basis
Produce documents through the agreed secure channel and log request id, date produced and document list
Track examiner follow-up questions and criticisms to a written response with an owner and due date

testing.expected: Every examiner document request has a logged production date and document list
No document is produced to the examiner outside the logged production register

checklistGeneric: Submission made before the statutory due date
Confirmation artefact retained as filing evidence
checklistSpecific: Confirm reviewer sign-off is recorded on the report package before transmission
Submit through the jurisdiction-specified channel and file format for each state
Capture the acknowledgement or confirmation number returned by the regulator or statistical agent
Update the filing calendar entry to Submitted with the submission date and confirmation reference
Store the submitted file and confirmation in the retention repository against the filing record

testing.expected: Each filing shows submission date and regulator confirmation reference
No calendar entry remains Open after its statutory due date

checklistGeneric: Test sample drawn on a risk basis and documented
Every tested attribute has a pass/fail conclusion
checklistSpecific: Select the test sample weighted toward denials, delayed payments and high-complaint states
Test each file for acknowledgement within the state deadline and evidence of the acknowledgement in the file
Test each payment against the prompt-pay clock: date of complete proof of loss to date payment issued
Test each denial for a written explanation citing the specific policy provision and appeal rights where required
Record a pass/fail per attribute and raise an exception with owner for every fail

testing.expected: Payment issue date is recorded and testable against proof-of-loss date
No tested attribute is left without a pass or fail conclusion

checklistGeneric: Tracking refreshed on the published period cadence
Method and rule matrix version pinned to each run
checklistSpecific: Refresh the acknowledgement, investigation and denial deadline data marts for the period
Pin the state rule matrix version used so historical rates remain reproducible
Recompute rolling 3-month and 12-month compliance rates alongside the current period
Reconcile the exception count in the tracker against the timeline monitor output
Publish the refreshed tracker and record the run date and rule matrix version

testing.expected: Each tracked period stores the rule matrix version used to compute it
Rolling 3-month and 12-month rates are recalculated alongside the current period

checklistGeneric: Every complaint logged on receipt with the regulator due date
Complaint linked to the underlying claim record
checklistSpecific: Log each DOI complaint with state, complaint number, receipt date, regulator due date and complainant
Link the complaint to the claim number and the handling adjuster in the claims system
Categorise the allegation (delay, denial, settlement amount, service, unfair practice) using the standard taxonomy
Record the outcome and any regulator finding once the complaint closes
Reconcile the complaint log to the state complaint index counts each quarter

testing.expected: Each complaint record holds state, complaint number, due date, claim link and category
The underlying claim is flagged as complaint-linked

checklistGeneric: Guideline change version-controlled with an effective date
Change communicated to handlers before it takes effect
checklistSpecific: Identify the guideline sections, letter templates and system SLA rules affected by the regulatory change
Draft the revised guideline text citing the new requirement and its effective date
Route the draft to compliance and claims leadership for approval and record the approvals
Publish the new version to the claims guideline repository and retire the superseded version
Notify affected handlers and confirm the change is reflected in the diary/SLA configuration before the effective date

testing.expected: Current guideline version shows an approval record and effective date
No superseded guideline version remains published as current

checklistGeneric: Closure code selected from the controlled list, not free text
Closure recorded by the handler with authority for the file
checklistSpecific: Select the closure reason code matching the actual disposition (paid, denied, withdrawn, closed without payment, settled)
Confirm the closure code is consistent with the payment history: no paid-closure code on a zero-payment file
Set the claim and each exposure to Closed; confirm no exposure remains Open on the claim
Enter the closure date and confirm it is not back-dated ahead of the last financial transaction
Add the closing file note summarising the disposition and the basis for closure

testing.expected: Claim status is Closed with a controlled-list closure reason code
No exposure remains in Open status on a closed claim

checklistGeneric: Retention class applied per the record retention schedule
Legal hold checked before any archival disposition
checklistSpecific: Confirm all claim documents are indexed to the claim number in the repository before archival
Apply the retention class for the line of business and loss jurisdiction, and set the destruction eligibility date
Check for an active litigation hold or subrogation/reinsurance dependency and suppress destruction if present
Confirm the archived file is retrievable by claim number after archival by opening it once
Record the archive date and retention class on the claim record

testing.expected: Retention class and destruction eligibility date are set on the archived claim
No claim under legal hold is scheduled for destruction

checklistGeneric: Every checklist item answered before closure is permitted
Exceptions approved by a supervisor, not self-waived
checklistSpecific: Open the closure checklist on the claim and work each item in order rather than bulk-ticking
Confirm coverage position, liability decision and damages evaluation are all documented in the file
Confirm subrogation and salvage were evaluated and the outcome recorded, including a documented no-pursue decision
Confirm all correspondence obligations are complete: final letter to insured/claimant issued and filed
Route any incomplete item for supervisor exception approval and record the approver and reason

testing.expected: All checklist items are answered before the claim can be set to Closed
No checklist item is waived without a recorded supervisor approval

checklistGeneric: Financial position reconciled between claim system and payment system
No pending or failed transaction left open at closure
checklistSpecific: List all indemnity and expense payments on the claim and confirm each is in Issued or Cleared status
Confirm no payment sits in Pending, Held, Rejected or Void-and-reissue state
Confirm every recovery (subrogation, salvage, deductible, second-injury fund) is either received or formally written off
Reconcile total paid on the claim against the payment/disbursement system for the same claim number
Confirm outstanding vendor and expert invoices are received and paid or accrued before closure

testing.expected: No transaction remains in Pending or Held status on the closing claim
Total disbursed reconciles to total paid on the claim record

checklistGeneric: Metric fields validated at closure, not backfilled later
Nulls in required metric fields block the closure feed
checklistSpecific: Confirm loss date, report date, assignment date and closure date are all populated to compute cycle time
Confirm the initial reserve and final incurred are both present so reserve accuracy can be measured
Confirm payment issue dates are captured so payment timeliness can be measured against settlement dates
Confirm line of business, cause of loss and closure reason codes are populated for segmentation
Run the closure feed validation and correct any claim rejected for missing metric fields

testing.expected: No closed claim enters the feed with a null loss, report, assignment or closure date
Initial reserve and final incurred are both recorded on the closed claim

checklistGeneric: Reserve zeroed by an explicit transaction with a rationale
Zeroing performed within the handler authority level
checklistSpecific: Open the financials and confirm outstanding indemnity reserve is zero on every exposure
Confirm outstanding expense/ALAE reserve is zero including defense and expert reserves
Post the closing reserve movement with a rationale note rather than letting the system auto-zero silently
Confirm the reserve release amount is within the handler authority; route for approval where it exceeds it
Verify no recovery reserve remains open where the recovery is still being pursued

testing.expected: No non-zero outstanding indemnity or expense reserve remains at closure
The closing reserve movement carries a rationale note

checklistGeneric: Cession identified against the correct treaty or facultative certificate
Recovery position agreed with ceded reinsurance before closure
checklistSpecific: Confirm whether the claim pierces any treaty retention or facultative certificate for the policy year
Confirm the reinsurer notification was issued within the contractual notification window and is evidenced in the file
Confirm the recovery billing was raised for the full ceded share of paid indemnity and allocated expense
Confirm cash received or, where outstanding, that the receivable is recorded and aged with a chaser date
Record the reinsurance completion confirmation on the claim before setting it to Closed

testing.expected: A recovery billing exists for every claim exceeding treaty retention
No claim closes with an unbilled reinsurance recovery

checklistGeneric: Executed originals or certified copies filed, not drafts
Documents indexed so they are retrievable by claim number
checklistSpecific: Confirm the signed release is in the file, executed by every releasing party and dated
Confirm the release amount and payee match the settlement payment actually issued
Confirm any minor, estate or guardianship settlement carries the required court approval order
Confirm lien satisfactions (medical, Medicare/MSP, statutory, attorney) are documented as satisfied or waived
Confirm dismissal or stipulation documents are filed on litigated claims

testing.expected: A fully executed release is filed for each settled exposure
No settled claim closes with an outstanding unsatisfied lien on file

checklistGeneric: Coverage position reached on the reopened facts, not copied from the original decision
Position documented with policy language
checklistSpecific: Re-read the policy in force at the date of loss including endorsements for the reopened element
Assess whether the reopened loss is a continuation of the original claim or a new occurrence
Test the reopened element against any exclusion, sublimit or aggregate erosion from the original payment
Document the coverage determination with policy provision citations and the supporting supplemental findings
Obtain coverage/technical referral sign-off where the reopened exposure exceeds the handler authority

testing.expected: A new coverage position document exists dated after the reopen date
No reopened claim is adjudicated on the original coverage memo alone

checklistGeneric: Analysis based on the full reopen population for the period
Drivers categorised, not listed as free text
checklistSpecific: Extract all claims reopened in the period with original closure date, reopen date and days-closed interval
Categorise each reopen driver: premature closure, missed recovery, late supplemental damage, litigation, medical deterioration, error
Compute reopen rate by line, team and adjuster and compare against the prior period
Isolate reopens within 30 days of closure as a premature-closure indicator and quantify them separately
Document the top drivers with claim exemplars and hand them to the quality and training owners

testing.expected: Each reopened claim carries a categorised reopen driver
Reopen rate is reported by line, team and adjuster with prior-period comparison

checklistGeneric: Assignment made within the standard turnaround from reopen
Handler authority matched to the reopened exposure
checklistSpecific: Assess the reopened exposure value and complexity to set the required handler skill and authority level
Route back to the original handler where they remain available and the reopen is not error-driven
Route to a senior or complex-loss handler where the reopened exposure crosses the large-loss threshold
Set the claim owner and supervisor in the system and confirm the assignment date is recorded
Notify the assigned handler with the reopen reason and the original file summary

testing.expected: Reopened claim shows a current owner with an assignment date after the reopen date
No reopened claim above the large-loss threshold is assigned below the required authority level

checklistGeneric: Notification issued inside the loss-state regulatory window
Copy of the communication filed against the claim
checklistSpecific: Identify the loss-state deadline that applies to the reopened coverage decision and diary it
Draft the coverage position letter in plain language stating the decision and the policy provisions relied on
Include appeal, review or complaint rights where the state or policy requires them on a denial
Issue the letter to the insured and, where applicable, the claimant attorney within the deadline
File the issued letter and the send date against the claim and close the diary entry

testing.expected: Coverage position letter is filed with a send date inside the regulatory window
No reopened denial letter omits the policy provision relied on

checklistGeneric: Investigation scoped to the reopened element only, not a full re-investigation
Findings documented contemporaneously
checklistSpecific: Define and document the specific question the supplemental investigation must answer
Obtain the new evidence supporting the reopen request (supplemental estimate, new medical records, new damage photographs)
Take a supplemental recorded statement where the factual account has changed from the original file
Engage an expert or re-inspection where the supplemental damage claim is disputed, and record the assignment
Compare the new evidence against the original investigation findings and document the reconciliation

testing.expected: New evidence obtained after the reopen date is indexed to the claim
A note reconciles the supplemental findings against the original investigation

checklistGeneric: Timing tested against the loss-state limitation period and the policy suit clause
Conclusion documented with the dates relied on
checklistSpecific: Identify the date of loss, date of original denial or closure, and any tolling events on the file
Apply the loss-state statute of limitations for the cause of action and record the computed expiry date
Check the policy contractual suit-limitation or proof-of-loss clause and whether it shortens the period
Check for any written extension, tolling agreement or waiver in the file that changes the date
Record the conclusion (open or time-barred) with the dates relied on, and refer to counsel where the position is arguable

testing.expected: A note records the computed limitation expiry date and the dates relied on
No time-barred claim is reopened without a documented legal referral

checklistGeneric: Request logged with receipt date on arrival
Decision to reopen or decline recorded with reasons
checklistSpecific: Log the reopen request with the requester, receipt date and the stated basis for reopening
Confirm the request is supported by new information, not a restatement of facts already decided
Check the original closure documentation to establish what was decided and what was paid
Assess whether the new information, if accepted, could change the outcome; document that assessment
Record the decision to reopen or decline and notify the requester with reasons within the standard turnaround

testing.expected: Reopen request record shows requester, receipt date and stated basis
No reopen request is declined without a documented reason and requester notification

checklistGeneric: Closure standard change traceable to the reopen driver evidence
Revised standard published with an effective date
checklistSpecific: Take the categorised reopen drivers and identify which closure checklist item failed to prevent each
Draft the closure standard or checklist amendment that would have caught the driver (e.g. mandatory subrogation sign-off)
Test the proposed amendment against a sample of recent reopens to confirm it would have prevented them
Obtain claims leadership approval and publish the amended closure standard with an effective date
Update the system closure checklist configuration so the new item is enforced, not advisory

testing.expected: Current closure standard version cites the reopen analysis that drove the change
New checklist item is configured as mandatory before closure

checklistGeneric: Payment or denial executed within the handler authority
Every disposition supported by the supplemental findings
checklistSpecific: Recalculate the additional amount owed from the supplemental evaluation and document the calculation
Confirm the payment is within the handler settlement authority and obtain approval where it is not
Verify the payee, tax details and any lienholder or attorney interest before releasing the payment
Issue the additional payment and confirm it reaches Issued status in the disbursement system
Where declining, issue the written denial of the supplemental claim citing the policy provision and file it

testing.expected: Additional payment or written denial is recorded against the reopened exposure
No supplemental payment exceeds the issuing handler authority without an approval record

checklistGeneric: Full closure checklist rerun on re-closure, not skipped as previously done
Lessons-learned note recorded
checklistSpecific: Rerun the complete closure checklist on the reopened claim rather than relying on the original closure
Confirm the reopened reserve is zero and all supplemental payments are Issued
Confirm any new release, supplemental release or dismissal covering the reopened element is executed and filed
Record the lessons-learned note stating why the claim reopened and what would have prevented it
Apply the re-closure code and confirm the claim shows a reopen count and a re-closure date

testing.expected: Re-closed claim shows a reopen count greater than zero and a re-closure date
A lessons-learned note is recorded on the re-closed claim

checklistGeneric: Reopen transacted in the system rather than opening a duplicate claim
Reopen reason recorded from the controlled list
checklistSpecific: Locate the original claim by claim number and confirm no duplicate claim has already been created for the same loss
Set the claim status to Reopen and select the reopen reason from the controlled list
Reopen the specific exposure affected rather than every exposure on the claim
Confirm the original file history, documents and financials remain attached and visible after reopening
Record the reopen date and confirm the claim appears in the reopened-claims report for the period

testing.expected: Status history shows a Closed-to-Reopen transition with a reason code
No duplicate claim exists for the same loss and policy after reopening

checklistGeneric: Reserve set on the supplemental evaluation with a written basis
Manager approval obtained above the change threshold
checklistSpecific: Evaluate the additional indemnity exposure created by the reopened element and document the components
Set separate indemnity and expense/ALAE reserves rather than a single blended figure
Record the reserve worksheet basis in the file, referencing the supplemental findings
Obtain manager approval where the reserve change exceeds the approval threshold
Diary the reserve for review at 30, 60 and 90 days from the reopen date

testing.expected: Reopened exposure has separate indemnity and expense reserves with a rationale note
No reserve change above the approval threshold is posted without a manager approval record

checklistGeneric: Diary dates set at reopen, not left to ad-hoc follow-up
Diary owner is the assigned handler
checklistSpecific: Set the initial contact diary to contact the insured or claimant within the standard window from reopen
Set investigation milestone diaries for the supplemental evidence requested (estimate, records, expert report)
Set the 30/60/90-day reserve review diaries from the reopen date
Set the regulatory decision diary against the loss-state coverage decision deadline
Confirm each diary is assigned to the current handler and none inherited a departed handler from the original file

testing.expected: Contact, investigation, reserve review and decision diaries exist with future due dates
No open diary on the reopened claim is assigned to an inactive user

checklistGeneric: Development measured on consistent accident-period cohorts
Data cut date stated on the analysis
checklistSpecific: Build paid and incurred development triangles by accident period for each line of business
Split the triangles by territory and cause of loss to isolate where development is concentrated
Compare current period-to-period development factors against the prior twelve-month average
Identify cohorts where incurred development exceeds tolerance and check for reserve strengthening or late reporting
Document the findings with the data cut date and the cohorts driving the movement

testing.expected: Triangles are produced by accident period, line, territory and cause of loss
Analysis states the data cut date used

checklistGeneric: Comparison uses like-for-like definitions across periods and sources
External benchmark source and vintage cited
checklistSpecific: Restate internal metrics on the benchmark definition before comparing (e.g. cycle time from report date, not assignment date)
Compare cycle time, severity, closing ratio and expense ratio against the prior four quarters

checklistGeneric: Metric definitions locked for the period and published with the result
